info.text:
Same 6 stops in Venice. In a random order you'd walk about 4.2 km. In the shortest order, 2.2 km.

1. Rialto Bridge
2. St Mark's Basilica
3. Doge's Palace
4. Santa Maria della Salute
5. Peggy Guggenheim Collection
6. Gallerie dell'Accademia

📌 Save this order for your trip.

Travelhour puts the places you swipe into walking order and guides you there. Free on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/travelhour-trip-planner/id6773093615

#venicetravel #veniceitinerary #walkingtour

Distances are estimates: straight line between stops plus 30% for streets.
